baked ziti (the GOOD one)

ok so this is the baked ziti my family asks for every single birthday. i've tweaked it for years and honestly i think i finally nailed it. the trick is browning the sausage REALLY well, don't rush it!! anyway here's how i make it, feeds 6-8 people or 4 hungry teenagers lol

Ingredients
1lb ziti or penne
1 lb italian sausage, casings removed (mild or hot)
1 tbs olive oil
1 onion, diced
3-4 cloves garlic minced
24oz jar marinara
1 can crushed tomatoes
red pepper flakes if you like it spicy
salt & pepper
15 oz container ricotta
1 egg
1/2 c parm, plus more for the top
2 c shredded mozz, divided
fresh basil

Directions
1. Heat the oil in a big pot and brown the sausage, breaking it up. Takes like 8-10 min. Add the onion and cook till soft then the garlic for another minute.
2. Pour in the marinara and the crushed tomatoes and a couple shakes of italian seasoning. Let it simmer while you do the rest, 15 min or so. Taste and add salt and pepper.
3. Drain the pasta when it's still a little firm because it keeps cooking in the oven.
4. Mix the ricotta, egg, parm and about half the mozz in a bowl.
5. Stir the pasta into the sauce. Put half in a 9x13, dollop the ricotta all over, then the rest of the pasta.
6. Top with the rest of the mozz and more parm.
7. Bake at 375 covered for a while, then uncover until bubbly and browned on top.

Let it sit 10 min before cutting or it falls apart. Freezes great too, just thaw overnight in the fridge before baking.
